A belief is retired by closing valid_to, never by
deleting the row. valid_to is null is the live set, and
the partial index keeps that the cheap query; history
survives because nothing edits the past.
mem.log has no valid_to and no update path: the record
of what was done only grows. Beliefs may be revised; the
